landing.heroTitle: Run your stores, counter POS, and warehouses from one place.
landing.heroSubtitle: Fast counter checkout, utang tracking, GCash and Maya float ledgers, and real-time warehouse-to-store replenishment built for growing retail.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything your counter and warehouse need

features.posBody: Split Cash, GCash, Card, and Utang tenders, Hold & Resume (F6), barcode scan, 58mm/80mm receipts, and offline outbox sync.
features.warehouseBody: Monitor multiple warehouses, spot low-stock stores, dispatch transfers in one click, and manage bin put-away and pick lists.
features.utangBody: Track customer credit balances with overdue warnings, GCash/Maya fees, and cashier X/Z shift close with denomination counting.
features.syncBody: Run on any browser or offline-first Android phone with role-based permissions for owners, admins, cashiers, and warehouse clerks.

landing.plansTitle: Built for single stores and multi-branch teams

plans.soloBody: Get selling in minutes with products, stock counts, utang ledger, expenses, and daily reports.
plans.fullBody: Coordinate multiple stores and warehouses with purchase orders, bin counts, stock transfers, shifts, and audit logs.
